Usage: okx [--profile <name>] [--demo | --live] [--json] <module> <action> [args...]

Global Options:
  --profile <name>   Use a named profile from /var/folders/kf/55pnhnhn4wgdxl6sdm6_0g8m0000gn/T/aegis-official-proof-j40t2o7e/.okx/config.toml
  --demo             Use simulated trading (demo) mode
  --live             Force live trading mode (overrides profile demo=true; mutually exclusive with --demo)
  --json             Output raw JSON
  --env              With --json, wrap output as {env, profile, data}
  --verbose          Show detailed network request/response info (stderr)
  --version, -v      Show version
  --help             Show this help

Modules:
  market      Market data (ticker, orderbook, candles, trades)
  account     Account balance, positions, bills, and configuration
  spot        Spot trading (orders, algo orders)
  swap        Perpetual swap trading (orders, algo orders)
  futures     Futures trading (orders, positions, algo orders, leverage)
  option      Options trading (orders, positions, greeks)
  earn        Earn products - Simple Earn, On-chain Earn, DCD, Flash Earn, and Auto-Earn
  bot         Trading bot strategies (grid, dca)
  event       Event contracts - binary outcome contracts (YES/NO, UP/DOWN)
  smartmoney  Smart money analytics - trader leaderboard, consensus signals, and position analysis
  config      Manage CLI configuration profiles
  setup       Set up client integrations (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude, etc.)
  pilot       Manage Pilot proxy resolver binary
  news        Crypto news, sentiment analysis, and coin trend tracking
  diagnose    Run network / MCP server diagnostics
  skill       OKX Skills Marketplace - search, install, and manage agent skills
  upgrade     Upgrade okx CLI and MCP server to the latest stable version
  list-tools  List all available tools and their parameters (use --json for machine-readable output)

Run "okx <module> --help" for module details.

Get latest ticker data for an instrument
  Usage: okx market ticker <instId>

Usage: okx-trade-mcp [options]

Options:
  --modules <list>     Comma-separated list of modules to load
                       Available: market, spot, swap, futures, option, account,
                                  event, news, smartmoney, skills,
                                  earn.savings, earn.onchain, earn.dcd, earn.autoearn, earn.flash,
                                  bot.grid, bot.dca
                       Alias: "bot" = bot.grid + bot.dca
                              "earn" / "earn.all" = all earn sub-modules
                       Special: "all" loads all modules
                       Default: spot,swap,option,account,bot.grid,skills

  --profile <name>     Profile to load from /var/folders/kf/55pnhnhn4wgdxl6sdm6_0g8m0000gn/T/aegis-official-proof-j40t2o7e/.okx/config.toml
                       Falls back to default_profile in config, then "default"
  --site <site>        OKX site to connect to: global, eea, us, tr (default: global)
                       global -> www.okx.com, eea -> eea.okx.com, us -> us.okx.com, tr -> tr.okx.com
  --read-only          Expose only read/query tools and disable write operations
  --demo               Enable simulated trading (injects x-simulated-trading: 1)
  --live               Force live trading mode (overrides profile demo=true; mutually exclusive with --demo)
  --no-log             Disable audit logging (default: logging enabled)
  --log-level <level>  Minimum log level to write: error, warn, info, debug (default: info)
  --help               Show this help message
  --version            Show version

Credentials (priority: env vars > /var/folders/kf/55pnhnhn4wgdxl6sdm6_0g8m0000gn/T/aegis-official-proof-j40t2o7e/.okx/config.toml > none):
  OKX_API_KEY          OKX API key
  OKX_SECRET_KEY       OKX secret key
  OKX_PASSPHRASE       OKX passphrase

Other Environment Variables:
  OKX_SITE             OKX site: global, eea, us, tr (overridden by --site flag)
  OKX_API_BASE_URL     Optional API base URL override (overrides --site mapping)
  OKX_TIMEOUT_MS       Optional request timeout in milliseconds (default: 15000)

Initialize a new configuration profile interactively
  Usage: okx config init [--lang zh]

tools.title: List Stock Tokens

instId.description: Optional: filter by specific instrument ID, e.g. AAPL-USDT-SWAP

demo.description: Query simulated trading (demo) market data. Default: false (live market data).

tools.name: market_get_instruments_by_category
tools.title: List Instruments by Category
tools.description: Discover tradeable instruments by asset category. Stock tokens (instCategory=3, e.g. AAPL-USDT-SWAP, TSLA-USDT-SWAP), Metals (4, e.g. XAUUSDT-USDT-SWAP for gold), Commodities (5, e.g. OIL-USDT-SWAP for crude oil), Forex (6, e.g. EURUSDT-USDT-SWAP for EUR/USD), Bonds (7, e.g. US30Y-USDT-SWAP for crude oil). Use this to find instIds before querying prices or placing orders. Filters client-side by instCategory.

instId.description: Optional: filter by specific instrument ID

demo.description: Query simulated trading (demo) market data. Default: false (live market data).

tools.name: market_filter
tools.title: Screen Instruments
tools.description: Screen / rank instruments across SPOT, SWAP, or FUTURES by multi-dimensional criteria: price range, 24h change %, market cap, 24h volume (USD), funding rate (SWAP), open interest (USD), listing time. Returns ranked rows with full ticker snapshot. Use to find top movers, high-OI contracts, newly listed tokens, etc. No credentials required. Do NOT use to get OI change rankings across contracts - use market_filter_oi_change instead. Do NOT use to get OI time series for a single instrument - use market_get_oi_history instead.

instType.description: Instrument type to scan. OPTION is not supported.

baseCcy.description: Filter by base currency, e.g. BTC

quoteCcy.description: Filter by quote currency. Comma-separated list supported, e.g. USDT or USDT,USDC

settleCcy.description: Filter by settlement currency (SWAP/FUTURES only), e.g. USDT

instFamily.description: Filter by instrument family (SWAP/FUTURES only), e.g. BTC-USD

ctType.description: Contract type filter (SWAP/FUTURES only): linear or inverse

minMarketCapUsd.description: Minimum market cap in USD (SPOT only; ignored for SWAP/FUTURES)

maxMarketCapUsd.description: Maximum market cap in USD (SPOT only; ignored for SWAP/FUTURES)

sortBy.description: Sort field. Default: volUsd24h. Note: marketCapUsd is only meaningful for SPOT (null for SWAP/FUTURES). To rank by OI *change* (oiDeltaPct / absOiDeltaPct), use market_filter_oi_change - market_filter only sorts by the current snapshot.

sortOrder.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Default: desc

tools.name: market_get_oi_history
tools.title: Get Open Interest History
tools.description: Get open interest (OI) history time series for a single SWAP or FUTURES instrument. Returns per-bar OI in contracts, base currency and USD, plus bar-over-bar delta and delta %. Useful for tracking how OI evolves around price moves. No credentials required. Do NOT use to compare OI changes across multiple contracts - use market_filter_oi_change instead. Do NOT use to screen instruments by current OI level - use market_filter instead.

limit.description: Number of data points to return (default 50, max 500)

ts.description: Return bars with timestamp <= this value (Unix ms). Used for historical pagination.

tools.name: market_filter_oi_change
tools.title: Find Open Interest Change Instruments
tools.description: Find SWAP or FUTURES instruments with significant open interest changes over a given bar window. Returns ranked rows with current OI (USD), previous OI (USD), OI delta (USD and %), price change %, 24h volume and funding rate. Ideal for spotting unusual accumulation/distribution or confirming trend momentum. No credentials required. Do NOT use to get OI time series for a single instrument - use market_get_oi_history instead. Do NOT use to screen by current OI absolute level or other non-OI metrics - use market_filter instead.

bar.description: Bar window for OI change computation: 5m, 15m, 1H, 4H, 1D (case-insensitive on server, but send canonical form here). Default: 1H

minOiUsd.description: Minimum current OI in USD (filters small/illiquid contracts)

minVolUsd24h.description: Minimum 24h volume in USD (filters low-activity contracts)

minAbsOiDeltaPct.description: Minimum absolute OI change % threshold, e.g. 1.0 means |oiDeltaPct| >= 1.0%

sortBy.description: Sort field. Default: oiDeltaPct (largest movers first, signed - longs and shorts separate). Use absOiDeltaPct to sort by |oiDeltaPct| (largest-magnitude moves regardless of direction). fundingRate is also supported for SWAP. Do NOT use the market_filter tool's sort fields (chg24hPct, marketCapUsd, listTime) here - they are not in the OI-change Row.

sortOrder.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Default: desc

tools.name: market_get_pair_spread
tools.title: Get Pair Spread
tools.description:
Compute spread statistics between two instruments over a lookback window. Returns absolute and ratio spread (mean / stdDev / median / min / max) plus an optional realtime spread snapshot. Use to size pairs trades, detect mean-reversion setups, or compare cross-listed contracts. Results are cached ~60s per (pair, bar, window) tuple. Read-only, no credentials required.
Do NOT use to fetch raw candles (use market_get_candles) or single-instrument OI/funding (use market_get_oi_history / market_filter_oi_change).

instIdB.description: Second instrument ID; must differ from instIdA

bar.description: Bar size for the spread series. Default 15m. 1m is not supported.

window.description: Lookback window. Format <n><unit>, units m/H/D/W (case-sensitive), max 1W. Default 1W.

backtestTime.description: Anchor timestamp (ms epoch) for backtest mode. When provided, realtime is omitted.

tools.name: market_get_indicator
tools.title: Get Technical Indicator
tools.description: Get technical indicator values for an instrument. Common indicators: ma, ema, rsi, macd, bb (Bollinger), kdj, supertrend, ahr999. Call market_list_indicators first to see all valid names. No credentials required.

indicator.description: Indicator name (case-insensitive), e.g. 'rsi', 'macd', 'bb', 'ma', 'ema', 'kdj', 'supertrend'. Call market_list_indicators to see all valid names. Using an invalid name will return an error.

params.description: Indicator-specific parameters as a number array. Examples: MA/EMA [14] (period), MACD [12,26,9] (fast,slow,signal), BB [20,2] (period,stdDev), RSI [14] (period). For period-based indicators a parameter is required; the CLI applies a sensible default when omitted.

returnList.description: Return a historical list instead of the latest value only. Default: false

limit.description: Number of historical records to return (only used when returnList=true). Default: 10

backtestTime.description: Backtest timestamp in milliseconds. Omit for live (real-time) mode

tools.name: market_list_indicators
tools.title: List Technical Indicators
tools.description: List all supported technical indicator names and descriptions. Call this before market_get_indicator to discover valid indicator names. No credentials required.
